title: Global-sections and stalk coordinates for a morphism from an affine tilde module
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, p a prime of A, i an integer, L an object of the derived quasi-coherent category of Spec(A) [lem-pc-affine-derived-cohomology-presentation], and V an A-module. Let d:tilde(V) to H^i(L) be any sheaf module morphism. Put b=unit(V) followed by Gamma(d), where unit(V):V to Gamma(tilde(V)) is the canonical global-sections isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction]. For every x in V localized at p, affineDerivedCohomologyStalkIso applied to the localization of b(x) is stalk(d) applied to the canonical tilde stalk localization of x [lem-weil-pbc-spec-tilde-stalk-localization]. No invertibility of d is assumed.

source.place: Tags 01HV and 01I7: stalk localization and the mapping property of tilde; formal naturality and adjunction-triangle calculation

proof.text: For a module map b:V to G, reuse affineTildeStalk_naturality from AffineDerivedCohomologyPresentation (available through a proof-only import all) to identify the stalk map on numerators. Extend by IsLocalizedModule.ext. Applying map_iso_commute identifies the corresponding maps on fractions.

Set W=H^i(L), G=Gamma(W), and b=unit(V) followed by Gamma(d). Naturality of the tilde/Gamma counit shows tilde(b) followed by counit(W) is d: the left adjunction triangle cancels tilde(unit(V)) followed by counit(tilde(V)).

Expand affineDerivedCohomologyStalkIso as tilde stalk localization followed by the stalk of the counit. Substitute the fraction naturality equality from step 1 and compose stalk maps; step 2 gives the required stalk map of d.

proof_origin.place: affineTildeStalk_naturality (reused via import all), tilde.adjunction.left_triangle_components, fromTildeΓNatTrans.naturality and IsLocalizedModule.map_iso_commute

theorem affineTildeGlobalSectionsStalk_coordinates
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (i : ℤ) (p : PrimeSpectrum A)
    (L : schemeDerivedQCohCategory (Spec (.of A))) (V : ModuleCat.{u} A)
    (d : (tilde.functor (.of A)).obj V ⟶
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)) i).obj L.obj)
    (x : LocalizedModule p.asIdeal.primeCompl V) :
    affineDerivedCohomologyStalkIso A i p L
        (LocalizedModule.map p.asIdeal.primeCompl
          ((tilde.isoTop (R := .of A) V).hom ≫
            (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of A)).map d).hom x) =
      (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace p).map d
        ((IsLocalizedModule.iso p.asIdeal.primeCompl
          (StructureSheaf.toStalkₗ A V p)) x)
